description: Close up, the gold is a lattice of fine pipework laid over the glass like a jeweller would lay it, and every tank is warm to the palm. Inside, a body hangs in amber at the exact temperature of blood, unfinished in ways you do not look at twice. A small enamel plate at the foot of each carries a name, a policy number, and a date that has not happened yet.
name: the vat colonnade
